_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil regime has produced zero ±2-point moves in 73 windows and the analyst's divergent factors (low MVRV, negative ETF flows, flat stablecoins) block the accumulation thesis needed to justify an upward phase shift, making HOLD the skilled call until a confirmed breaker emerges.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil base rates and factor divergences, while the narrative writer implies a loaded-spring breakout setup; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and self-aware track record tip consensus to HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.003% with ETF flows turning positive and MVRV Z-score climbing above 30 — would signal accumulation dynamics matching the Aug 2024 analog and justify shift to Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with exchange netflow turning sharply positive and CVD breaking below 20th percentile — would signal risk-off liquidation forcing phase down to Anxiety or Panic
